$modelSpecs: Per-SKU capability metadata for harnesses that must be TOLD what a model can do. GET /v1/models returns ids only — no context window, no capabilities — so a custom-endpoint client (Cline's models.json, Zed's available_models) has no way to discover this. Without it those clients fall back to conservative defaults and compact context far too early. 512K for neolite is the documented sealed-budget ceiling; the 1M figures match what the harnesses have shipped since 0.2.0.

harnesses.name: Cline
harnesses.notes: Re-verified 2026-08-10 against saoudrizwan.claude-dev 4.1.7 and Cline CLI 3.0.52: Cline 4.x (VS Code/JetBrains) and the standalone CLI share one global config at ($CLINE_DIR||~/.cline)/data/settings/providers.json, with model metadata in a sibling models.json. CLINE_PROVIDER_SETTINGS_PATH relocates providers.json. Cline 3.x kept the provider in VS Code globalState, so `on` still prints paste-in values for that case.

harnesses.name: Cursor
harnesses.notes: Re-verified 2026-08-07 against the installed Cursor build: native BYOK is stored in an encrypted, server-synced store (aiserver.v1 byok/apiKeyCandidates/baseUrlCandidates), NOT settings.json — the string 'cursor.models.' never appears in Cursor's workbench bundle. Configured via Settings → Models UI and requires Cursor Pro/Ultra. CLI prints paste-in values. Scriptable alternative: Claude Code extension (`neosmith claude on`).

harnesses.name: OpenCode
harnesses.notes: Verified 2026-08-22 against opencode.ai/docs (config, providers, troubleshooting). Custom provider block: provider.neosmith.npm='@ai-sdk/openai-compatible' (the /v1/chat/completions package; @ai-sdk/openai is for /v1/responses), options.baseURL + options.apiKey, models.<sku>.limit.{context,output}, plus top-level model/small_model as '<provider>/<sku>'. Global config path is ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json on EVERY platform including Windows (%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode). OpenCode reads opencode.jsonc in preference when it exists, and .jsonc legally has comments and trailing commas — the harness never rewrites a file JSON.parse cannot read; it prints the block to merge by hand.

harnesses.name: OpenClaw
harnesses.notes: Verified 2026-08-22 against docs.openclaw.ai (gateway/configuration, concepts/model-providers). Provider block: models.providers.neosmith.{baseUrl,apiKey,api:'openai-completions',models[]}, selected via agents.defaults.model.primary='neosmith/<sku>'. Two hazards drive the module: the file is JSON5 (comments/trailing commas/unquoted keys legal), and 'OpenClaw only accepts configurations that fully match the schema — unknown keys, malformed types, or invalid values cause the Gateway to refuse to start'. So the written block carries exactly the documented keys and nothing else, and a JSON5 file this CLI cannot parse is never rewritten — `on` prints the equivalent `openclaw config set` commands instead.

harnesses.name: Junie CLI
harnesses.notes: Verified 2026-08-22 against junie.jetbrains.com/docs (custom-llm-models, environment-variables, junie-cli-model-selection). One JSON file per custom profile at $JUNIE_HOME/models/<profile>.json (JUNIE_HOME defaults to ~/.junie); the filename stem IS the profile id, selected as `junie --model custom:<id>`. A profile holds ONE model — there is no catalogue field the way opencode/openclaw have — so `on` writes one file per SKU (neosmith-pro / -basic / -lite / -maestro, from manifest.models) plus a `neosmith` alias pointing at the tier that was wired. Each tier profile beyond the alias is snapshotted under the compound id `junie-profile-<tier>`, the `-profile-` convention lib/originals.js already understands. Fields: id, baseUrl, apiType ('OpenAICompletion' | 'OpenAIResponses' | 'Google' | 'Anthropic'), apiKey (literal, or ${VAR}), displayName, providerName, maxContextLength, primaryModel/fasterModel. UNLIKE every other harness here, baseUrl is the FULL endpoint — JetBrains' own example is http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions — so the profiles point at <router>/v1/chat/completions. Confirmed against the router on 2026-08-23: POST /v1/chat/completions returns 200, POST /v1 returns 404, so a profile pointing at the /v1 root every other harness writes would fail every request. No documented persistent default for a custom profile; `on` prints both `--model custom:neosmith` and the platform-correct JUNIE_MODEL export.
